text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: He resonates with my magic. He is drawing too much power. At this rate, the entire city will be destroyed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわの魔力と共鳴しておるな。
あやつめ、
力を引き出しすぎじゃ。
このままでは街ごと滅んでしまうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: So, Illya... What's the plan this time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでイリヤ、
今回の作戦は？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: ...No petty tricks. It's best to use force.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……小細工は抜きじゃ。
力には力でぶつかるのが一番。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: I see. Primitive and simple... There's that kind of beauty to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどね。
原始的でシンプル……
そういう美しさもあるよね。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That's how it is. Yuki, are you ready?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうことじゃ。
ユキよ、
準備はよいか？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Of course. You too, Illya. Make sure you make me look good♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんだよ。
イリヤこそ、
しっかりボクを引き立ててよね♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Let me show you the power of the one who rules the night! Let me Show you the strength of the One who rules beauty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夜を統べる者の力、見せてやろうぞ！
美を統べる者の力、見せてあげるよ！
